profile.headline: Software Engineer at Walkerhealthforce
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 10+ years of enterprise experience driving the design, development, and modernization of secure web applications, REST APIs, and database systems. Proven expertise in the C#/.NET ecosystem, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and DoD/Healthcare compliance. Adept at bridging the gap between technical execution and  business strategy and managing full lifecycle technical projects to support critical mission objectives. Maintains active Certified Scrum Master (CSM) credentials, with DoD Secret Clearance eligibility.
